summary: Comprehensive backend+frontend testing of GROOM2B landing redesign. Backend contact API (POST/GET /api/contact) fully functional with proper 201/422 handling. Frontend: hero, nav (with scroll-based blur), collections bento (6 CDN images load), arrivals tabs (3 products with INR prices per tab), occasions hover highlight+image swap, contact form (HTML5 validation + successful submission + persisted lead + success state with first name + toast), mobile menu, and horizontal overflow all pass. Minor: occasion-item testids use name-slug (e.g., occasion-item-wedding) not numeric index (occasion-item-0); hero headline splits 'The man' / 'of the moment.' across two lines (semantically correct, matches spec intent).
action_items: Minor: Spec expects occasion-item-0..5 numeric testids; implementation uses name-slug (occasion-item-wedding, etc.). Consider adding numeric variants if required by spec, otherwise update spec. Functional behavior (hover changes active crimson + swaps image) works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: ContactLead inherits ContactLeadCreate; using response_model=ContactLead with EmailStr field - fine. In list_contact_leads the created_at string->datetime conversion is OK.
No file-size or DRY issues. Pydantic validation present. CORS wildcard acceptable for preview. Env vars used correctly.
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via axios in ContactForm (verified lead posted to backend).
seed_data_creation: Inserted TEST_-prefixed contact leads via API tests and UI form; safe test data, not production critical.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All feature tests from the request pass. Backend pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (reusable). Occasion items use name-slug testids. Hero headline renders across two lines ('The man' + 'of the moment.') via separate elements but full phrase present in hero section inner text when ignoring whitespace.
